title: Non-adjustable time limit
user_impact: Users need more time to enter data and may lose data through timeouts.
technical_impact: Missing refresh or timeout handling in the script/markup.

checks.applicability: Every page (a fixed page-wide UNTESTED note).
checks.expectation:
Emits one page-wide UNTESTED note on every page, never a pass and never a
violation. Strictly, 2.2.1 applies only where content sets a time limit, so
a page without scripts or forms would be out of scope; the note is
unconditional today, which is why no not-applicable case exists.
checks.manual_reason: Script-driven time limits (setTimeout/setInterval, session expiry) and whether users can turn them off, adjust or extend them are not visible in the DOM. The id is historical: it names the 2.2.1 page note for script time limits, while the actual meta refresh detection is timing/meta-refresh.
